description: This file is a shell script used for testing and demonstrating the behavior of Git's atomic push feature, including setup functions, test cases, and hooks to verify push operations under various conditions.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Creates a pair of repositories 'upstream' and 'workbench' and configures the 'upstream' repository to warn on current branch updates, also sets up remote details in 'workbench'.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Compares the specified refs in the upstream and workbench repositories to verify they point to the same commit hash.

methods.name: fmt_status_report
methods.description: Formats the output of Git push status reports, filtering relevant lines.
